app.name: Polihole
app.description: Two discussion-starter card decks for political science students: Polihole and Politicize This.

home.tagline: Two card games for starting arguments. Neither one settles anything.

polihole.title: Polihole
polihole.blurb: A claim or question on every card. Agree, disagree, or stall convincingly.
polihole.finishedNote: {count} discussions, nothing changed. Or did it?

politicize.title: Politicize This
politicize.blurb: The Politics of X. Make the case for why it matters.
politicize.finishedNote: {count} words. Shuffle for a new order.

install.ios: Add {name} to your home screen: tap {share}, then "Add to Home Screen."

about.title: About
about.intro: Two decks of prompts for people who enjoy arguing about politics.
about.lead: Nothing is scored, nothing is saved, and nobody wins.

sections.heading: Polihole
sections.body: Deals a political claim or question. Argue for it, argue against it, argue about arguing.

sections.heading: Politicize This
sections.body: Deals a single word and nothing else. Make the case for why it's political. Thank you for coming to my Ted Talk.

items.name: Offline
items.body: Both decks are bundled with the app, so it runs with no connection once it's open. Add it to your home screen and it behaves like any other app.

items.name: Open source
items.body: Every card, and the app around them, is on {source}. Corrections and additions welcome.

items.name: No tracking
items.body: No accounts, no analytics, no cookies. Where you are in a deck is remembered by your browser and never leaves your device.

about.credits: This project was inspired by {askhole}, the {leftValues} and {politicalCompass}.
about.affiliation: No affiliation with any of them.
about.disclaimer: And no endorsement of any card content.
